name: Important People of History: Presidents - George Washington
source: Learn all about George Washington in this visual novel biography containing rare photos from inside the Washington Monument, Washington's home at Mount Vernon, and much more. Soldier, General, Spymaster, and President - this is George Washington!
translation: 透過這部視覺小說傳記，瞭解喬治．華盛頓的生平。作品收錄了華盛頓紀念碑內部、他在弗農山莊的故居以及許多其他地方的珍貴照片。士兵、將軍、諜報首腦、總統——這就是喬治．華盛頓！
